```kql
// Detects curl/wget downloading a script into /tmp that is then executed by bash/sh on the same host (download-and-execute)
let downloadWindow = 10m;
let downloads = DeviceProcess
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("curl", "wget")
| where CommandLine contains "http"
| where CommandLine contains "-o /tmp/" or CommandLine contains "-O /tmp/" or CommandLine contains "--output=/tmp/" or CommandLine contains "-o=/tmp/"
| extend DownloadedPath = extract(@"-+[oO](?:=|\s+)(/tmp/[^|;&'\"]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| project DeviceId, DownloadTime = Timestamp, AccountName, DownloaderFileName = FileName, DownloaderPid = ProcessId, DownloadCommandLine = CommandLine, DownloadedPath;
let executions = DeviceProcess
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("bash", "sh", "dash", "zsh")
| where CommandLine contains "/tmp/"
| extend ExecutedPath = extract(@"(/tmp/[^\s|;&]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| project DeviceId, ExecTime = Timestamp, ExecutingUser = AccountName, ExecutionParent = ParentFileName, ExecutedScript = CommandLine, ExecutedPath, ExecutingPid = ProcessId, ExecutionInitiatorPid = InitiatingProcessId, ExecutionInitiatorCommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
executions
| join kind=inner downloads on DeviceId
| where ExecTime between (DownloadTime .. (DownloadTime + downloadWindow))
| where ExecutionInitiatorPid == DownloaderPid or isnotempty(
